nodes.title: Photosynthesis
nodes.definition_plain: The process by which plants convert light energy into chemical energy.

sources.quote: Photosynthesis converts light energy into chemical energy.

nodes.title: Light Energy
nodes.definition_plain: Energy carried by photons, captured by chlorophyll.

nodes.title: Water
nodes.definition_plain: An input to photosynthesis, split to release oxygen.

nodes.title: Carbon Dioxide
nodes.definition_plain: An input to photosynthesis, source of carbon for glucose.

nodes.title: Glucose
nodes.definition_plain: A sugar produced by photosynthesis, used for plant growth.

nodes.title: Oxygen
nodes.definition_plain: A gas released as a byproduct of photosynthesis.

nodes.title: Biology Basics
nodes.definition_plain: The foundational unit covering cells, energy and reproduction.

nodes.title: Cellular Respiration
nodes.definition_plain: The process cells use to release energy from glucose.

sources.quote: Cellular respiration releases energy from glucose.

nodes.title: Mitochondria
nodes.definition_plain: The organelle where cellular respiration takes place.

sources.quote: Cellular respiration occurs in the mitochondria.
